reviews.x: Bought this for my Wife for an early Christmas gift, and she loves it. Her favorite thing about it is the rollers. There removable so if you aren’t a fan you can simply take them out. It also has the ability to keep the water very warm while using. It heats up room temperature water in about 10 minutes (wife says that pretty good lol) also she says it’s deeper than most of the foot spas she’s had in the past. Overall please with the purchase. Happy wife=happy life 👍🏽🤙🏽

Just received.  Filled it up, poured some salts, and soaked.  It didn't leak, so far.  It does heat the water, gets hot quickly, in about five minutes.  Have to keep turning the heat on and off since the heat doesn't maintain, but small inconvenience, no big deal.  Not bad for $40.  Will update if anything changes.  I believe we have had this for a couple months.  It  is still working well.  No leaking.  Asked my son if he noticed anything about his feet, and he seems to think it soothes and rel

reviews.t: I LOVE IT.  Great if you want a hot foot soak
reviews.x: i us e this every night!  I plug it in about 1/2 hour before I use it so that the water is really hot.  I only use the heater, the vibration and bubbles are weak and don't do much.  But the heater works and keeps the water hot!  I use foot bombs that I purchased from Etsy, soak my feet for 20 - 30 minutes, and then gently scrub with a pumice stone.  My feet are soft and look good.
My size 14 feet fit! And for the price it works great, heats up quick and doesn't leak.

reviews.t: Heaven has landed below my feet..
reviews.x: Amazing, if you don’t have one you’re missing out. Never used to soak my feet and as a guy it’s not something we typically do. With some recent foot issues I purchased one with some tea tree and rosemary and Wow! Feet feel amazing so I use it 2-3x a week before bed and it makes me feel renewed each time. Solid heater, solid vibration mode, and bubbles are great. The heater can maintain the water at spa temps so take caution before heading feet first you may be surprised. Edit: been using this fo
I like the way it looks and the way it heats. Bubbles could be better. It seems to leak a little. Does make my feet feel good when I'm done. Works well for the price.
if this product vibrates, I can't tell. Other stuff works
Great buy. Both the wife and I love it. She’s pregnant right now and have four swelling issues and this foot bath is very soothing and relaxing for both her and I.

reviews.t: Item simply doesn't work. Should be taken off of Amazon. Makes Amazon look bad.
reviews.x: This item is worthless. I do not even want to put one star beside it. Does not heat. better off if you buy a 5-gallon bucket and fill it full of hot water.

reviews.t: Great foot bath for the price!
reviews.x: The first one I got did not work, but I returned it and got a replacement and this one works great! The heater really makes the water toasty and the bubbles and vibration work great.
Not enough room to move the feet from back to front

reviews.t: Great product, it does what I need it to do
reviews.x: I had read other reviews that complained about the bubbles and vibration not being strong enough.  I was surprised that the vibration and bubbles were stronger than I expected. However, I didn't care about that, the main thing I needed was for the water to stay hot, and it does. As others have said, you have to turn the heat off periodically, or it gets too hot. I did not mind that.  The main thing I didn't like about it was that the bottom is all nubby. I have a very sore foot, and it was painf

This product works very well for relaxing and exfoliating feet. I have used oils in it and it seems to be working fine still. I wish it had a deeper basin to cover my foot up to the ankles. The heat is the perfect temperature and the device is simple to use and easy to clean.
This is my first foot spa and I love it.  I love the carry handle along with everything else.  Great product and made with heavy duty material.  Helps my feet feel great.

reviews.t: the product was a waste of money for me.
reviews.x: the vibration and bubbling stopped the very first day of using the product. very disappointing and up to date it doesn't work anymore!
Purchased as a gift for my son.  Hes had multiple surgeries on his feet and ankles and this provides much need pain relief!
Works very well. Only down side, becareful how much qatwr you put in. With the bubbles and massage, very easy to overflow
Works great although the rollers at the bottom do not move on there own
Love the fact that it has heat so the water stays warm.

reviews.t: Work hurts my feet, this fixes my feet
reviews.x: I have never been one for self pampering, but when I started my job which involves me being on my feet for 8 hours and walking around 12 miles a day I knew I needed a way to relax and fix my sore feet. This allowed me to come home, throw in some water and just relax. I love the feeling of the hot water on my feet and the vibration feels so nice! I use it once or twice a week and every time it is the best part of my week!

Product looks great. The bubbles are useless and vibration is so minimal I thought it was not working. I could feel nothing with my feet so put my hand in and detected a very small vibration. The temp is not variable and was too hot for me. I am very disappointed.
Works pretty good but the cord is a bad length can barely get from the outlet right behind the couch top the front of the couch. Need to plug in to an extension cord. Thought that was unpractical.
The vibrating bubbles were not exactly very strong. It does get very warm and ita relaxing in that aspect. But save yourself a few dollars and get a model without the vibrating bubble function.
Amazing product. Works very well, and the water gets very hot. I just switch to just vibration/bubbles when desired heat is reached. My feet thank me every time I use it. Definitely recommend.
I LOVE IT. The temperature is nice, the bubles are just right and this is not as noisy. You can roll your feet for self message or not and both are very confortable. Even my husband loves it!

claims.text: Many reviewers say the heater works well and heats water quickly, keeping it hot for a soak.
Several reviewers find the bubbles and vibration weak or ineffective.
Reviewers frequently call it a great value for the price.
A few reviewers report leaking or a unit that did not work, though some got a working replacement.
Some reviewers mention limited basin size or depth for their feet.
